name: Gamigin
source: An S grade devil affiliated to <Paradise Lost> where Lucifer is king. Some devils say he is a dragon, while others say he is a handsome, bright devil. He is always next to Lucifer, the most mysterious being in Hell, and other devils are sometimes shocked at seeing him talk to Lucifer freely and playing jokes on him.
